summary.text: Zakary Pereira is the Democratic candidate for the Rhode Island House of Representatives, District 22, in the November 3, 2026 general election.

In a Ballotpedia survey, his campaign biography said he is a lifelong Rhode Islander who works at the University of Rhode Island helping military veterans turn their service experience into college credit.

paragraphs.text: In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, Zakary Pereira said he graduated from North Kingstown High School in 2012 and from Rhode Island College in 2016 with degrees in History and Political Science.
He said he worked as Senior Assistant Director of Admissions at Salve Regina University and completed an MBA there in 2022.
That year he challenged incumbent Joseph Solomon Jr. in the Democratic primary for Rhode Island House District 22 and lost, 67.2 percent to 32.8 percent.
Pereira advanced from the September 9, 2026 Democratic primary for the seat.

His 2026 survey responses listed affordability, including protecting Medicaid and helping working families afford homes; public safety; and opportunity, including public education and career and technical education, as his key messages.
Ballotpedia lists the National Education Association Rhode Island, Clean Water Action and Planned Parenthood Votes! Rhode Island among his endorsers.
